title: Visibility-Based Calibration of Low-Cost Particulate Matter Sensors
content: Comparison with manufacturer calibration revealed substantial deviations due to differences in aerosol optical properties, highlighting the importance of application-specific calibration. The visibility-based approach enables real-time, continuous calibration of low-cost sensors with minimal equipment, offering a scalable solution for PM monitoring in resource-limited or remote environments. The method’s robustness under varying environmental conditions remains to be explored. Nevertheless, the results establish visibility-based calibration as a reliable and accessible framework for enhancing the accuracy of low-cost PM sensing technologies.
